ideas.idea: Add address, url and openingHours to the Dentist JSON-LD
ideas.why: The contact page JSON-LD has only name and telephone, while the address is already in the page text, so labelling it helps machines read the business details.

ideas.idea: Back up the 'thousands of patients' claim with a real number or review
ideas.why: This is a general trust-and-content tip with little effect on how the site is found or read.

ideas.idea: Show actual prices on the services page
ideas.why: The page says 'prices are simple and clear' but lists none, so people and machines get no pricing information.

ideas.idea: Name the dentists with qualifications on the team page
ideas.why: The team page has only a vague 'decades of experience' line and names nobody.

ideas.idea: Give each service its own page
ideas.why: The four services are bare list items with no URLs, so none can be found or described on its own.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: This is valid but low-impact on a four-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Check that the hero image /img/reception.jpg exists
ideas.why: No image file is in the repository and .eleventy.js passes through only robots.txt and sitemap.xml, so the image would 404.

ideas.idea: Add og:title and og:description social tags
ideas.why: base.njk has none, but this is standard advice for almost any site and only affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Add internal links from the team and contact pages to services or contact
ideas.why: The nav already links every page, so extra links add little.
